'''Vikurs''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as an agent of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. At some point, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] uncovered an old [[House Thul's holocron|holocron]] composed of historical intel about [[House of Thul]]'s former crimes and barbaric acts and Vikurs and his men were able to discover the Jedi's discovery by intercepting a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]]' communication. Knowing that House Thul's status could be harmed if the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron's]] contents were released to the public, Vikurs tasked an Imperial-aligned individual to retrieve it, from the Jedi and [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]] forces on the [[Organa dig site]], and then give it to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Urduun]] at [[Outpost Bolym]]. At that time, Vikurs was suffering from temporary chest pain due to an indigestion and was taking anti-stress medication.<ref name="'TOR'">{{TORcite|type=general|An Incriminating Holocron|Alderaan}}</ref>
